what: The six assertions guarding DEF-025 and DEF-028, and the six mutation arms each was watched to fail against. Source-level and comment-stripped: PhoneEmptyState explains itself by naming PhoneMessageBlock, so a raw-text match would stay green after the code was deleted.
green_run: 􁁛  Test "centring did not leak into the block the other eight states use" passed after 0.001 seconds.
􁁛  Test "the never-paired state is centred and carries its illustration" passed after 0.001 seconds.
􁁛  Test "the action moved to a sibling rather than being deleted" passed after 0.001 seconds.
􁁛  Test "the message block draws no action of its own" passed after 0.001 seconds.
􁁛  Test "the never-paired case renders the empty state, not the notice block" passed after 0.001 seconds.
􁁛  Test "the unreadable state places the action below its block" passed after 0.001 seconds.
􁁛  Suite "Phone settings — where the action sits and how the empty state reads" passed after 0.001 seconds.
􁁛  Test run with 6 tests in 1 suite passed after 0.001 seconds.

arms.mutation: PhoneMessageBlock regains an `action` field and draws `entry.actionLabel` again
arms.targets: the message block draws no action of its own

arms.mutation: PhoneBlockActions' primary Button is deleted rather than moved
arms.targets: the action moved to a sibling rather than being deleted
arms.why_it_matters: Without this arm DEF-025 could be closed by removing the recovery control entirely — the block would draw no action and the first assertion would pass.

arms.mutation: the never-paired case renders PhoneMessageBlock again
arms.targets: the never-paired case renders the empty state, not the notice block

arms.mutation: both multilineTextAlignment(.center) calls removed from PhoneEmptyState
arms.targets: the never-paired state is centred and carries its illustration

arms.mutation: multilineTextAlignment(.center) added to PhoneMessageBlock's body text
arms.targets: centring did not leak into the block the other eight states use
arms.why_it_matters: Without this arm DEF-028 could be closed by centring all nine states, which is one state's design applied to the eight the design left-aligns.
arms.note: The first attempt at this arm reported ARM INVALID — its anchor matched 0 times because the trailing comment differed. Recorded rather than silently re-run: an arm whose anchor misses is not an arm that passed.

arms.mutation: PhoneBlockActions removed from the unreadable case
arms.targets: the unreadable state places the action below its block

restore: Every arm restored with `cp` from a baseline taken before the first mutation, never `git checkout` — a prior session destroyed uncommitted work in this repository that way. All six assertions green again after restore, and the full suite reads 1518 tests in 189 suites passing.
not_proved: That the rendered control sits below the card in pixels, or that the glyph rasterises and the column reads as centred on a device. The committed SURF-018 captures predate this change and are not evidence for it. A fresh on-glass capture is named outstanding work rather than claimed.
